focus.title: Built Around Your Process.
focus.body: Every refinery, gas plant, and industrial facility operates under distinct thermal, chemical, and pressure parameters. Reliable performance begins with selecting technology engineered for your specific operating environment.
focus.approach_body: We evaluate operating conditions first, then align and source precise molecular sieves, catalysts, water treatment chemistries, and performance additives.

plant_map.title: Inside an Industrial Process
plant_map.body: Explore how specialized chemistries and adsorbent media integrate across critical operating units.
plant_map.unit1_body: Deep moisture removal down to < 0.1 ppmv to prevent hydrate formation in cryogenic exchangers.
plant_map.unit2_body: Advanced scale, corrosion, and biological control formulations to maintain optimal heat transfer efficiency.
plant_map.unit3_body: High-activity catalyst media and contaminant traps designed for maximum cycle length.

divisions.title: Industrial Capabilities
divisions.v1_body: Synthetic zeolites and activated aluminas for gas dehydration, LNG processing, and purification.
divisions.v2_body: Scale inhibitors, corrosion control, biocides, and membrane chemistries for industrial cooling.
divisions.v3_body: Refining and synthesis catalysts designed to maximize yield and extend unit cycle lengths.
